name: hermes

spawn.doc: Headless worker via tools/hermes_run.py, which drives `hermes -z` with a per-spawn --model (and --reasoning from --effort; the model-picker config is ignored so workers can't rewrite this Hermes install) and prints a claude-shaped result JSON, so host.py --role auto-records the ledgers. In-process alternative: delegate_task has NO per-spawn model (children inherit the parent's) and returns no usage block — only use it when spawning hermes -z is impossible, and hand-record usage via cost.py record --source estimated.
spawn.effort_flag: PMOS_EFFORT=<effort> (maps to hermes --reasoning; unsupported values run at the model default with a pmos_note)

list_models_note: reads Hermes' model-catalog caches (~/.hermes/cache/openrouter_curated.json, model_catalog.json — the picker's source of truth). `hermes model --refresh` refetches them when the list looks stale.
env_note: set provider to a Hermes provider name (e.g. QwenTokenPlan) when your account's ids are ambiguous across configured providers — auto-detection mis-routes then. Empty = Hermes decides.

usage.doc: hermes_run.py turns the `-z --usage-file` report into the shared .usage shape (input_tokens/output_tokens); host.py spawn --role records it automatically.

file_scope_hooks.doc: no file-scope edit hooks on this path; workers are hermes -z processes with YOLO forced by oneshot — do-not-touch is enforced at the checkpoint (trace.py unplanned), not at edit time. Keep PMOS_WORKSPACE pointed at the project tree.
